title: Chapter 732
paragraphs: Chapter 732
Episode 184. Beyond Destiny (4)
In response to Jin's determination, as if shouting.
The fleet spat out fire again, and the dragons expelled their breath. The body of the Chaos Dragon and the remnants of the Black Line were being oxidized in that shock wave.
In the dizzying barrage, Jin kept watching the inside of the castle gate.
He could feel the gloomy energy emanating from within quickly amplifying.
'Is it a knight? It's quite impressive.'
The sharp hostility spreading from within the castle pricked his skin.
He had not expected to fight Rosa immediately upon arriving at the castle. After all, he didn't come alone.
"Bale."
[Why?]
"The guy inside is taking too long. Go and see what he's doing."
"That's a good idea."
When Hedo agreed with Jin, Bale frowned.
[You want me to go into the castle gate alone?]

"Yes. No one else is more suitable to inspect that dark place than you. Sending Nameless Assassins would take too long. Plus, if a situation arises where special power like a counter-field is needed inside, you can escape more easily, right?"
[Haa.]
Bale, sighing, spread his two wings.
His annoyance towards Jin and Hedo was igniting into a raging power from the blade of Shakan.
[Damn, how did my fate end up like this!]
Boom-!
Bale raised a cloud of dust and stormed towards the castle gate.
The allies, maintaining their tension, watched his back disappear into the castle gate.
Even after Bale went in, there were no special signs inside the castle.
However, about thirty seconds later, most of the allies had to let out a sigh of frustration.
Because a robust knight came out from the castle, dragging Bale by the hair with his left hand on the ground.
In his right hand, he was holding a longsword at least twice the length of Bale. It was a similar shape to when Shakan was a longsword Bale.
[I wanted to see how good a guy you're so fond of, your grace.]
Clunk, spit!
The knight threw Bale in front of his feet and spat.
Like Lionel, he was glowing with a faint purple unlike other knights of chaos. Only the knights who had escaped from the sublime had such a form.
[It's disappointing. Naturally, I thought he would be capable enough to sweep this side all by himself. But to send this kind of puppet first... Disappointment, disappointment, it's truly endless.]
As he was speaking, Jin bowed his head in frustration.
"I was complacent."
"We were complacent."
Jin and Hedo spoke simultaneously.
The fact that all of their allies were witnessing Bale in such a pitiful state sent chills down their spines.
"Anyway, the problem is his rapid recovery, Sir Hedo."
"Yes, he has a belief that he can't die easily, so he ends up in such a state. That fool is now trying to cut down all the morale of our allies that you've just built up."
"It's my fault for trusting Bale. I can't argue with that."
[Hey, aren't you supposed to listen when people are talking?]
"That guy is also complacent. There must have been a lot of reports about Bale to the side of the Chaos, I wonder where this arrogance comes from."
"It's probably his skills... Hmm!"
Swing-!
Suddenly, a sharp flash of light came from the knight's longsword.
The fifth secret technique of Runcandel, Light Speed Pierce, passed between Jin and Hedo.

[A gutless and impudent guy. Even though you are rebelling now, not long ago, I heard you were the most promising knight of Runcandel. Shouldn't you show some respect to me before fighting? You surely know what it means that I was buried in the Sublime.]
Jin couldn't help but let out a hollow laugh.

"Those who devoted themselves to Runcandel in life and in death. Those who dedicated their body and soul for the survival and prosperity of the family. Those who defended the family to the end no matter what disaster came."
[I know well. And?]
"Why is such a person standing there?"
[What?]

"You probably met almost all of the conditions I just mentioned in your lifetime. That's why you could be buried in the Sublime. But now, where is your soul heading? As the Chaos drives the family to the brink of extinction, why are you standing there, what are you trying to uphold?"
The knight didn't answer, just glared at Jin.
[A guy who has never been a family head is trying to teach me...]

"Whether you were a family head or a regular knight, it's not important. The only thing that matters is whether you're fulfilling your duty after death now that you've awakened from the Sublime. I'll give you the first and last chance to fulfill that duty. Stand with me now and prove that Runcandel's struggle will not be bent by the power of Chaos."
[It's getting ridiculous!]
"Will you respond to my words?"
Spit! The man spat out once more.
[Is that an answer? I am Senka Runcandel! The 11th head of the Sword family and the one who came back from death once again for Runcandel.]
"Senka, I will strip you of the right to be interred again in the tomb, and revoke the castle of Runcandel from you."
At the moment Senka was about to reply, Jin took a deep breath and looked at Bale, who was still lying in front of the gate.
"Bale! Stop this and get up to deal with him."
"Damn..."
Bale sluggishly got up.
As Jin and Hedo said, the reason why Bale had come out, being led by the hair by Senka in such an ugly way, was because he had been off guard.
As soon as he entered the castle, Senka's sword pierced his chest, and his aura exploded within his body, nearly bursting his entire body.
This did not particularly harm Bale. To erase the 'trace of life' that is Bale, it must be backed by the power of Genesis or something equivalent.
However, Bale had decided to lie down for a while and suppress his shameful feelings.
'Ah, it's embarrassing. I hope that Padler kid isn't watching this from somewhere...'
Fortunately, it didn't seem like he felt Padler's energy around him.
More than anyone else, he didn't want to show this disgraceful behavior to Padler.
A smirk appeared on the face of Senka, who was watching Bale.
[I was wondering when you would finally get up, puppet.]

[Why are you trying to match me after giving Jin a rant about our ancestors earlier? Are you feeling like you've accomplished something because you stabbed me once when I was off guard? Huh? Do you think I'm easy because I was lying down, angry?]

Perhaps due to the increasingly rough days and uncomfortable situation, Bale was using somewhat coarse language. It might also have been influenced by the Murakan dialect imitation often taught by Enya.

[Indeed, as Officer Padler said, you are a lowly puppet. But I've already taken your life once, so I'm not interested. I'll set my friends on you and the others, so get along and wait until the duel between the rebel, Jin Runcandel, and me is over.]
As Senka raised his arm.
Chaos-ridden knights and monsters began to pour out from the opened castle gate.
An incalculable large army.
They had been waiting at the boundary of the castle gate since Senka stepped out of the castle.
Bale dyed the entire front line with golden power even before the army took their positions.
As a glowing ring floating above Bale began to resonate with the widely spread power, the spectacle of the Thugs' troops all exploding in unison followed.

[You just said you're going to duel with Jin... but with you? How on earth? Even if all of your subordinates who are blowing up in real-time come at him all at once, they would at best give him a scratch. I bet the Thug himself didn't even hope you could take on Jin?]

Although Senka didn't lose his composure even while witnessing the futile death of his troops, after seeing the golden power covering Shakan becoming more intense, he had to feel the chill running down his spine.
Bale was a being who became one of the ten knights with his overwhelming power alone during the heyday of Runcandel.
On the other hand, Senka was a house master during the time when Runcandel was in its most severe decline.
What Jin described as having weight, and what Hedo acknowledged as a substantial ability. Those were just evaluations that he could be a 'gatekeeper of the Thugs' at best.
After reaching here at last.
There had been too many tough battles. Senka couldn't pose even a small crisis to Jin and his companions now.
As Bale had said, Senka did not qualify to cross swords with Jin.
Senka was a man who had become the head of the house without having ever lived in a desperate era like now.
Tsuaak-!
As Shakan fell onto Senka's head, their battle began.
Even after the duel had begun, Bale showed the ease of continuing to burn the troops coming out of the gate.
Senka thought.
No matter how massive Bale's power was, he couldn't possibly handle all the troops.
Naturally, the fleet's shelling would follow, and once the melee began, he felt he would have to regain his breath and fight.
Bale, who had not let his guard down, was clearly standing a few steps above him.
As time passed, Senka had to focus more and more on Bale, reducing his calculations on anything outside the duel, namely the overall situation.
Bale, on the other hand, focused more on annihilating the troops of Chaos by himself than on Senka.
The end of the battle between the two came after Senka's longsword shattered into pieces, and the arms that held it disappeared somewhere.
[Hu, huuk……!]
Senka, who had knelt on one knee, looked around with a bewildered face.
During the fight, the fleet did not once shell the battlefield, and there were no surviving troops of Chaos.
Among the mountains of black corpses, Jin was walking.
"Knight Senka, from now on you are no longer a Runcandel. Also, when the war ends, no one in the world will retrieve your remains."
[Keukkeuk…… are you really the one to decide that, when the rightful head of the house is still breathing in there. Your rebellion cannot succeed.]
Jin slowly turned Senka's head.
To where his gaze reached beyond the darkness inside the castle from which he had emerged earlier.

"Those who enter that darkness today and point their swords at Rosa will have names that shine forever, but those who forgot to struggle and couldn't escape the embrace of the Thugs in the end will have names buried in contempt and be forgotten."
Senka's face twisted.
Jin looked down at his eyes, struggling to suppress his tremor.
He felt his death approaching.
Although the Knights of the Tomb can be resurrected through the power of the Thugs, Rosa never intended to revive him from the beginning.
Jin thought that was obvious. Rosa had never cared for his kind even when she was human.
Pulsuk!
Senka fell to the ground.
Jin passed him and slowly walked into the darkness of the castle.
Hedo and Bale, as well as his comrades who had been waiting for him after descending, were following him without realizing it.
